## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature, lab exercise, or data pipeline extension you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a specific problem or DEA-C01 exam domain? Please describe.

## Proposed Solution / Design
Describe the solution or architectural changes you would like to see:
- Architectural changes (CDK constructs, Lambda handlers, Glue jobs)
- Data contracts or schema modifications
- Cost and teardown impact (must maintain near-zero idle cost principles)

## Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or links to AWS documentation.
